history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review relevant clauses relating to implementing partner risk adjustments in the operational handbook for country-based pooled funds, with a view to ensuring that risk levels of implementing partners are reviewed and revised within a reasonable time frame.
history.administration_response: Management will strengthen risk management practices around partner risk levels in the revised Global Guidelines for Country- based Pooled Funds. Under the revised Guidelines, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs will include a requirement for the fund manager to review and validate a partner’s assigned risk level based on the performance index score on a regular basis. The revision of the Global Guidelines will be finalized in the second quarter of 2022.
history.board_assessment: Given that the revised of Global Guidelines for Country-based Pooled Funds, which will include requirements on reviewing and adjusting the risk levels of implementing partners based on the performance index score, has not yet been finalized, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review relevant clauses relating to implementing partner risk adjustments in the operational handbook for country- based pooled funds, with a view to ensuring that risk levels of implementing partners are reviewed and revised within a reasonable time frame.
history.administration_response: Management requests that this recommendation be closed. Practices regarding the management of partner risk levels were strengthened in chapter 5.4.2 of the revised global guidelines for country-based pooled funds and a requirement that fund managers review and validate partners’ assigned risk levels based on the performance index score on a regular basis was added in paragraph 248. The revised global guidelines were issued in December 2022.
history.board_assessment: Given that the revised global guidelines for country-based pooled funds, which include strengthened practices regarding the management of partner risk levels, has already been issued, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
